title: Fix initials() using only the test failures
problem: initials() should turn a full name into its uppercase initials, but some tests fail. Run pytest, read each failure (got vs expected, the 'where' line, the file:line) and fix the function. Don't change the tests.
requirements: Return the first letter of each word, uppercased
Words are separated by any amount of whitespace
An empty or blank name returns an empty string
expectedBehavior: initials('ada lovelace') == 'AL'; initials('  grace   hopper ') == 'GH'; initials('') == ''
hints: Conceptual: there are two separate bugs. Run pytest -x, fix the first one, rerun, and repeat. One is about case, one is about how the name is split.
Specific: the IndexError comes from part[0] on an empty string. Which split call produces empty strings? (L03, section 2.)
Implementation: loop over full_name.split() (no argument) and add part[0].upper() to the result.
evaluation: The fix addresses the causes (split and case); no special-casing of test inputs
